units.source_text: 卯槌是用桃木或玉、犀角、象牙制成的一个小槌，长三四寸，用五色丝线装饰。

en.t: An u-zuchi was a small mallet made from peach wood, jade, rhinoceros horn, or ivory, three or four sun long, and decorated with five-colored silk threads.

units.source_text: 正月里第一个卯日用以辟邪。

en.t: It was used on the first Day of the Hare in the first month to ward off evil spirits.
